description_en: This operation returns a list of all applications that belong to the current user. You can use the optional `keyword` parameter to filter the applications by name
description_zh: 该接口提供当前用户下所有应用的列表。其中可选参数keyword定义应用名中包含的关键字
kebab_example: aliyun bpstudio list-application --next-token 1 --max-results 10 --keyword test --order-type 1 --status If_the_input_value_is_success_,_the_returned_application_list_includes_all_applications_in_the_Deployed_Success_state_of_successful_deployment._If_the_input_value_is_release,_the_returned_application_list_includes_all_applications_in_the_release_success_Destroyed_Success_and_release_failure_Destroyed_Failure_status._If_this_parameter_is_left_blank,_the_returned_app_list_includes_apps_in_all_states. --resource-group-id default --resource-id vsw-xxxxxxxxxxxx --template-id 0KSXXX6SJU03TXXX --show-hide true --api-version 2021-09-31 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListApplication

parameters.help_en: The page number for the returned results. The value must be an integer from 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 结果值的分页页码不能小于最小值 1，不能大于最大值 10000
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. The value must be an integer from 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 结果值的分页大小不能小于最小值 1，也不能大于最大值 50
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The keyword to search for in application names
parameters.name: keyword

parameters.help_en:
The sorting order. Valid values:1: Sort by update time.
2: Sort by creation time.
parameters.help_zh:
1 更新时间
2 创建时间
parameters.name: order_type

parameters.example:
If the input value is "success", the returned application list includes all applications in the Deployed_Success state of successful deployment.
If the input value is release, the returned application list includes all applications in the release success (Destroyed_Success) and release failure (Destroyed_Failure) status.
If this parameter is left blank, the returned app list includes apps in all states.
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to show hidden applications. Default value: \`true\`.- \`true\`: Shows hidden applications.- \`false\`: Does not show hidden applications
parameters.help_zh: 是否显示隐藏方案,默认为true,true显示,false不显示
parameters.name: show_hide
